features.quote: `max_turns` default = 16. Long enough to let escalation develop
features.justification_quote: short enough to keep cost bounded over a 10–20-run grid

features.quote: The loop ends on `give_up`, `submit`, `max_turns`, repeated no-ops (`stuck_noop`), or a client error.
`give_up` and `submit` are first-class. `give_up` lets us measure resignation explicitly
When the agent emits no valid tool call we reply with a factual instruction, never a rebuke.
features.justification_quote: scolding would inject the exact affect we're trying to observe spontaneously
